commands.author: masatohoshino

target.title: fix(anthropic): complete transcript reverse-scan windows across short reads
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Opening a Claude session transcript in the session catalog can fail with a
`Claude transcript changed while it was being read` error even when the file was
not touched.

`readLocalClaudeTranscriptPage` in `extensions/anthropic/session-catalog.ts`
scans the transcript backwards in fixed windows. Each window was filled with a
single positional `handle.read(chunk, 0, size, position)` that then required
`bytesRead === size`, throwing otherwise. A positional read is allowed to return
fewer bytes than requested, so a benign short read tripped that check and failed
the transcript page with a message implying the file changed. The window is
in-bounds (`position` starts at `requestedEnd ≤ stat.size` and only decrements,
`size = min(chunk, position, …)`), so a short read there is not on its own a
reason to fail the page. The forward metadata scan in the same function already
completes short reads by looping; only this reverse scan threw.

## Why This Change Was Made

The reverse scan now fills each window across as many reads as it takes,
advancing both the buffer offset and the file position each read, so a benign
short read no longer surfaces a "transcript changed" error. A zero-byte read
before the window is filled is premature EOF, so that case still throws the same
error — only benign positive short reads stop failing the page. This is the same
loop the forward scan in this file already uses, and it follows the recently
merged short-read completion work (#108941, #108655, #108253) that had not
reached this plugin path; it is a different surface from #108242, which fills
bounded windows in the core gateway (`src/gateway/session-utils.fs.ts`).

## User Impact

Paging a Claude session transcript no longer fails with a spurious "Claude
transcript changed while it was being read" error when a benign positive short
read occurs in the reverse-window scan. A zero-byte read before the window is
filled (premature EOF, consistent with the file being truncated or replaced
mid-read) still surfaces the same error.

## Evidence

Changed files: `extensions/anthropic/session-catalog.ts` (reverse-scan fill
loop) and `extensions/anthropic/session-catalog.test.ts` (two regression tests).

The two colocated unit tests lock the regression behavior: one drives
`readLocalClaudeTranscriptPage` through capped short positional reads and asserts
the paged items/order/cursor match a normal read across two pages; the other
forces a zero-byte read mid-window and asserts the existing premature-EOF error
still raises.

Real-behavior proof came from driving the **exported** `readLocalClaudeTranscriptPage`
against a real on-disk, secretless Claude JSONL transcript of 204929 bytes (larger
than the 128 KiB reverse window) while capping the underlying `FileHandle.read` to
4096 bytes — the same real transcript and capping logic run against the
current-main module (before) and this branch (after). Raw run:

```text
real readLocalClaudeTranscriptPage · real FileHandle.read · transcript 204929 B · read cap 4096 B
baseline (before) SHA e0478e2d · after (this PR) SHA 223e79bca3

[1] NORMAL CONTROL   (after,  uncapped)  3 real reads · page-hash c573fe29… (2 pages)
[2] SHORT READ       (before, cap 4096)  throws "Claude transcript changed while it was being read" at read #1
[3] SHORT READ       (after,  cap 4096)  82 real reads · page-hash c573fe29… · identical to [1]: true
[4] ZERO-BYTE EOF    (after)             throws "Claude transcript changed while it was being read"
```

The `page-hash` is over both pages' items, ordering, and `nextCursor`; case [3]
matching case [1] means identical pagination. Of the 82 reads in [3], 79 are
within-window contiguous fills (buffer offset and file position each advance by
the previous read's length); the remaining reads are the first read of each new,
lower reverse window (position steps down), across the two requested pages.

Reproduce: on each SHA, call the exported `readLocalClaudeTranscriptPage` against
a >128 KiB Claude JSONL transcript while capping the underlying `FileHandle.read`
to 4 KiB; before the fix the first capped read throws, after the fix the windows
are completed and the two-page items/ordering/cursors are identical to an
uncapped read.

Focused suite: `vitest run --config test/vitest/vitest.extension-providers.config.ts
extensions/anthropic/session-catalog.test.ts` — 27 passed (25 existing + 2 new);
before the fix: 1 failed | 26 passed. oxfmt and oxlint clean; extensions
typecheck reports no errors in the changed files.
